jobs.title: Senior Account Director, Growth Sales
jobs.description:
About Ontra
Ontra is the leader in AI-powered solutions for the private markets. Powered by industry-leading AI, data from over 2 million contracts, and a global network of legal professionals, Ontra automates critical private market workflows across the fund lifecycle. Ontra’s solutions transform unstructured data trapped in static documents into actionable intelligence, enabling firms to accelerate contracts, streamline compliance, and automate entity management. Trusted by more than 1,000 global GPs, investment banks, law firms, and advisors – including nine of the top ten PEI-ranked firms worldwide – Ontra helps firms focus on what’s important.

Our Culture
Ontra is built for people who want real ownership from day one in a remote-first environment that’s built to support it. Our customers are sophisticated, and our work reflects that. AI is engrained in how we work, and curiosity about it is part of who we are.

Ontranauts are sharp, genuinely collaborative, and invested in each other's success. They are excellent at what they do and even better to work with. That combination is rare, and we don't take it for granted. Learn more about our values https://www.ontra.ai/careers/#our-values.



For this job, we are currently only hiring candidates based in the United States, with a preference for candidates in New York City.

About the Role

Ontra is seeking a Senior Account Director, Growth Sales, reporting to our Managing Director, Growth Sales, to join our rapidly growing company.

The Senior Account Director will play a critical role in helping Ontra deepen relationships with our existing enterprise customers by increasing share of wallet through strategic cross-selling, bundled solutions, and expanded adoption of our AI-enabled products and services. Working within a sophisticated enterprise sales motion and leveraging the MEDDICC framework, you'll partner closely with Customer Success and Business Development to identify expansion opportunities, navigate complex buying groups, and close high-value opportunities with senior legal, compliance, operations, and executive stakeholders.

Whether you're an accomplished enterprise seller or a former corporate attorney looking to transition into a revenue-generating business role, you'll thrive in this position if you enjoy solving complex customer problems, building long-term strategic relationships, and helping shape how AI transforms legal and private markets workflows.

What you'll do

 - Own Strategic Account Growth: Drive expansion within Ontra's largest existing customers through cross-sell, upsell, and increased adoption of our AI-enabled products and services.

 - Lead Complex Sales Cycles: Manage opportunities from discovery through close, navigating multi-stakeholder buying groups and executive decision-makers using the MEDDICC framework.

 - Position Platform Solutions: Uncover customer needs and align the right combination of products and services to deliver measurable business value.

 - Partner Across Teams: Work closely with Customer Success and Business Development to identify expansion opportunities, coordinate account strategy, and accelerate growth.

 - Shape Our Growth Strategy: Share customer insights and market feedback to help refine our go-to-market approach and support the rollout of new offerings.

What you'll bring

 - Experience: 10+ years of enterprise B2B sales success, or 5+ years as a corporate attorney (ideally in funds, private equity, M&A, or leveraged finance/credit) looking to transition out of practicing law into a client-facing business role.

 - Enterprise Selling Expertise: Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and building relationships with legal, compliance, finance, or executive buyers. Experience selling AI-enabled services, legal technology, or professional services is a plus.

 - Private Markets Knowledge: Familiarity with the private equity ecosystem and the legal or operational workflows that support investment managers.

 - Consultative Approach: Skilled at uncovering customer challenges, identifying expansion opportunities, and positioning multi-product solutions that drive long-term value.

 - Cross-Functional Mindset: Collaborative, coachable, and comfortable partnering across Sales, Customer Success, and Business Development to win as a team.

 - Operational Excellence: Strong pipeline management, forecasting, organization, and communication skills.



Hiring Locations

We currently hire exclusively in the locations listed below. Select jobs may have more specific location requirements due to business needs.

United States

Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington

APAC

Hong Kong

EMEA

United Kingdom

Benefits Snapshot

 - Remote-first working policy, with office hubs in NYC, Santa Barbara, and London

 - Twice yearly team offsites for in-person collaboration

 - Paid flexible time off policy

 - Paid parental leave and benefits

 - Employer-supported retirement contributions, varying by country

 - Monthly phone and internet reimbursement

 - Company-sponsored learning and development resources, department budgets for professional development, and a robust onboarding program

 - Various options for medical, dental, and vision insurance

Travel 

Occasional travel is required for Ontra employees, including typically at least twice per year to attend team and larger group off-sites for in-person collaboration. For some roles, additional travel may be required based on the requirements of the role and business need.

Inclusivity

Ontra is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Ontra will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact people@ontra.ai.

For this job we are currently only hiring candidates based in the New York City Metropolitan area.



About the team & opportunity

Ontra is seeking a Customer Success Director to join its growing Contract Automation team!

Reporting to our Managing Director of Customer Success, you will serve as a subject matter expert in customer retention, lawyer management, and Ontra’s Contract Automation solution. You will act as a client advocate to ensure that our customers can achieve positive business outcomes throughout their partnership with Ontra. Proactive, energetic, and self-driven, you will strive to understand our customers within the asset management and financial services industries and work to be a trusted solutions-based partner so that customers stay and grow with Ontra.

This is a great opportunity for someone who has excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and an interest in working with top private equity firms and asset managers using industry-leading legal solutions. We’re looking for someone excited to champion customer satisfaction, nurture long-lasting relationships, and strategize to maximize client experience.



What you’ll do

 - Collaboration: Work with other Customer Success Managers and cross-functionally with teams including sales, product operations, and our Lawyer Network to support the day-to-day operations of the CS team and ensure a seamless customer experience

 - Customer Journey Management: Proactively manage and execute tasks throughout the customer journey to enhance client satisfaction and engagement, including facilitating the onboarding process for new customers

 - Relationship Management: Manage multiple client stakeholders and establish a foundation of trust and partnership in relationships via remote and in-person communication; accurately understand and proactively meet customer needs

 - Operations and Enablement: Update customer success management tools such as Gainsight, conduct customer call reviews using platforms such as Gong, and engage in training conversations for continuous improvement



What you’ll bring

 - Industry Experience: 4+ years of experience in a law firm environment is strongly preferred. Candidates with 5+ years of customer-facing experience in the financial services industry will also be considered, ideally with exposure to routine legal contracts such as NDAs, NRLs, vendor agreements, and other similar documents.

 - Written/verbal communication: You can communicate effectively in person, over Zoom and the phone, and via email with diverse stakeholders from a variety of backgrounds

 - Adaptability and Initiative: You have the ability to think about how the contributions of the customer success function impact the company, and are a self-starter with the ability to learn and execute quickly in a dynamic environment

 - Communication skills: You are an expert at distilling complex technical concepts into digestible language for customer-facing communication and training

 - Attention to detail: You have a keen ability to notice even the smallest errors and are committed to ensuring accuracy and precision in everything you do

 - Interest in in-person connection: You are willing and interested in working from our Midtown Manhattan office several days a week, with potential to travel up to twice per quarter to major U.S. cities to conduct in-person meetings with customers and key contacts

About the Role

For this job, we are currently only hiring candidates based in the New York City Metropolitan area, or who are willing to relocate.

Ontra is seeking a VP, Marketing, reporting to our Chief Revenue Officer, to oversee our Marketing team.

We're looking for someone excited to develop and lead a global marketing function that drives rapid, profitable growth, unite demand generation, product marketing, content, brand, events, and communications under a single data-driven operating plan, and establish Ontra as the premier name in AI-native services for private markets.

If you're a results-driven leader who owns the number, pairs strategic vision with strong execution, builds high-performing teams across geographies, and influences cross-functional partners through collaboration and curiosity, we'd love to get to know you.

What You'll Do

 - Lead a World-Class Marketing Organization: Assess, shape, and lead a team of 12 across multiple sub-functions, recruiting and developing top-tier marketers who deliver against pipeline and NRR targets.

 - Own the Growth Number: Set annual targets for marketing-sourced pipeline and revenue, define supporting funnel metrics and OKRs, and partner with GTM Ops on performance dashboards that keep the team accountable.

 - Power a Global Demand Engine: Design and run a segmented demand generation strategy across NAMER and EMEA, leaning into ABM, lifecycle marketing, and hosted events with an agile test, learn, and scale cadence.

 - Define Ontra's Story: Lead positioning, messaging, and content strategy, strengthening Ontra's brand as the leader in AI-native services for private markets.

 - Align Across the Go-To-Market Team: Build strong partnerships with Sales, Customer Experience, Product, Partnerships, and GTM Operations to optimize down-funnel performance from MQL to close.

What You'll Bring

 - Experience: 12+ years in B2B marketing, including 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary marketing teams of a comparable size and 3+ years marketing services solutions to enterprise buyers.

 - Industry and Domain Depth: Experience in legal tech, private equity, or private markets, ideally marketing AI-native services

 - Full-Funnel Leadership: Proven ownership of a complete marketing remit spanning brand and communications, positioning, demand generation, product marketing, and content, with a track record of setting and hitting marketing-sourced pipeline and revenue targets.

 - Enterprise and Regulated Market Expertise: Experience running account-based, multi-touch campaigns for C-suite personas and enterprise buying committees in highly regulated industries.

 - Global Operating Experience: Experience leading a marketing function across NAMER and EMEA, paired with an experimentation mindset that prioritizes tests and ships them quickly.
